framework: Research-only translation of publicly described institutional strategy families into China-mainland personal-market operating conditions. No market exposure, investment recommendation, product suitability assessment or order authority is approved.

strategy_controls.current_state: No account evidence, risk capital, tax facts, current holdings, broker/exchange permissions, named instrument or approved risk budget has been provided. User-reported futures qualification alone is not a contract-specific operating approval.
strategy_controls.research_universe_policy: Open direct-equity and public-market research universe. Every future named A-share, ETF, futures contract, option, REIT or other product requires its own data, suitability, liquidity and risk dossier before it can be a research candidate.
strategy_controls.fallback_policy: All unapproved sleeves remain in protected liquidity until their item-level dossier and independent review are complete.
strategy_controls.domestic_futures_status: reported eligibility not independently evidenced; all CTA and calendar-RV targets remain q=0
strategy_controls.crypto_activation_policy: Requires jurisdiction, legal/access, exact product, custody, venue, liquidity, tax, risk-budget and independent-review gates.
strategy_controls.execution_eligibility_policy: All current market-traded exposure is q=0. Any later manual action needs account/product eligibility, dated source facts, risk budget, tax/suitability review and independent verification outside this research system.
strategy_controls.performance_measurement: No return objective is claimed. Any later strategy evaluation must be point-in-time, use declared costs/slippage/taxes, model unavailable exits and reconcile both strategy TWRR and investor MWRR/XIRR when external flows exist.

pass_conditions: Every material institutional, market-structure and China/crypto boundary claim resolves to a source-registry ID or is explicitly marked as analytical translation.
The report distinguishes public manager self-description from proof of performance, causality or personal portability.
The matrix covers macro/risk parity, CTA, factor, fundamental/event-driven, relative-value/carry, stat-arb, volatility, PE, private credit and real-assets families.
Domestic A-share, domestic-futures and crypto conditions are separately stated for every material family.
The personal operating model covers data timing, account/contract eligibility, paper replay, costs, margin, liquidity, monitoring and invalidation.

Chinese reader-facing source and final PDF text contain zero eligible Chinese rhetorical-template hits, including every authored 不是 and 没有 occurrence plus paired-negative stacks; any immutable quotation, legal/regulatory text or source-title exception is labeled and recorded.
No named security, target price, product suitability result, allocation or execution instruction is implied; all exposure remains q=0.
XeLaTeX source, PDF, text extraction, build provenance, visual review, R0-R4 findings and final sign-off reconcile.
downgrade_path: research framework -> educational evidence memo only; never a personalised recommendation or live strategy approval without user-specific evidence and a new review cycle
